# FreeSurf Post — API Reference

Base URL: https://post.freesurf.tools

Free, open-source cross-posting API. Publish to X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram,
Threads, TikTok, YouTube, and Bluesky from your own apps.

## Authentication

Two ways to authenticate:

1. **API key** (recommended for apps): send `Authorization: Bearer fsp_live_...`
   or `FSP-API-KEY: fsp_live_...`. Generate and revoke keys in the dashboard
   (API tab). Keys are scoped to your account.
2. **Supabase JWT**: the dashboard's own session token (`Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`).

## Endpoints

- [Post now](#post-now) — `POST /api/post`
- [Schedule](#schedule) — `POST /api/schedule`
- [Scheduled posts](#scheduled-posts) — `GET /api/scheduled`, `DELETE /api/scheduled/:id`
- [Media](#media) — `POST /api/media/upload`
- [Teams](#teams) — `GET /api/teams`, `POST /api/teams`, `PATCH /api/teams/:id`, `DELETE /api/teams/:id`
- [API keys](#api-keys) — `GET /api/keys`, `POST /api/keys`, `DELETE /api/keys/:id`

## Post now

`POST /api/post`

A team is required — target it either by **name** (`team`) or **id** (`teamId`).
`team` names are unique per account. Use whichever is easier; `teamId` wins if both are sent.

By team name:

```json
{
  "platforms": ["x", "linkedin"],
  "text": "Hello world",
  "mediaUrls": [],
  "team": "Personal"
}
```

By team id:

```json
{
  "platforms": ["x", "linkedin"],
  "text": "Hello world",
  "mediaUrls": [],
  "teamId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6"
}
```

- `team` (required unless `teamId`): your team's name (e.g. `"Personal"`, `"citywallz"`).
- `teamId` (required unless `team`): internal team id (from `GET /api/teams`).
- `platforms` (required): array of platform keys (see [Platform keys](#platform-keys)).
- `text` (required): post body.
- `mediaUrls` (optional): Bundle upload ids (from `POST /api/media/upload`).
- `instagramImageFit` (optional): `"fit"` (default — adds padding) or `"crop"` (center-crops)
  so Instagram feed images outside 4:5–1.91:1 still publish. Applies to image posts only.

Response: `{ "id": "...", "results": [{ "platform": "x", "success": true, "postUrl": "..." }], "postedAt": "..." }`

## Schedule

`POST /api/schedule`

A team is required, same as Post now — by name (`team`) or id (`teamId`).

```json
{
  "platforms": ["x"],
  "text": "Later post",
  "scheduledAt": "2026-08-31T14:00:00Z",
  "team": "Personal"
}
```

- `scheduledAt` (required): future ISO 8601 timestamp.
- Posts publish within ~5 minutes of that time via a cron worker, to the team
  stored on the post (never an active-team fallback).

## Scheduled posts

`GET /api/scheduled` — list your scheduled posts.
`DELETE /api/scheduled/:id` — cancel a scheduled post.

## Media

`POST /api/media/upload` — upload a local file (multipart, field `file`), returns `{ "uploadId": "..." }`.

Then pass the upload ids in `mediaUrls` on `POST /api/post`. `text` is the caption.
Pass multiple ids for carousels (X, LinkedIn, Instagram). TikTok and YouTube require
a single video.

## Teams

`GET /api/teams` — list your teams (id, label, is_active).
`POST /api/teams` — create a team (`{ "label": "Personal" }`). Labels are unique
per account; a duplicate returns `409`.
`PATCH /api/teams/:id` — rename a team (`{ "label": "..." }`).
`DELETE /api/teams/:id` — delete a team.

Target a specific team when posting with `team` (by name) or `teamId` (by id):

```json
{ "platforms": ["x"], "text": "For my business", "team": "citywallz" }
```

```json
{ "platforms": ["x"], "text": "For my business", "teamId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6" }
```

## API keys

`GET /api/keys` — list your keys (metadata only, never the secret).
`POST /api/keys` — create a key (`{ "name": "..." }`); returns the raw key once.
`DELETE /api/keys/:id` — revoke a key.

## Platform keys

| Key       | Platform   |
|-----------|------------|
| `x`       | X / Twitter |
| `linkedin`| LinkedIn   |
| `facebook`| Facebook   |
| `instagram` | Instagram |
| `threads` | Threads    |
| `tiktok`  | TikTok     |
| `youtube` | YouTube    |
| `bluesky` | Bluesky    |
| `reddit` | Reddit    |
| `pinterest` | Pinterest    |
| `slack` | Slack    |
| `discord` | Discord    |
| `google_business` | Google Business    |

## Credits / X fees

`GET /api/credits` — balance (`balanceMicros`) and recent transactions.
`POST /api/credits/topup` — `{ "amountCents": 500 }` → Stripe Checkout, returns `{ "url": "…" }`.
`POST /api/credits/webhook` — Stripe webhook; credits the ledger on payment success.

X is metered: **$0.015** per plain/media post, **$0.20** for a post with a link.
Each successful X post is debited from your balance automatically.

## Notes

- **Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube** publish to a selected Page/Channel. Select it in
  the dashboard Accounts tab (or via `POST /api/channel/:platform`) before posting;
  otherwise the post may go to a default target or fail.
- **Instagram** feed images default to `autoFitImage` (padding). Pass
  `instagramImageFit: "crop"` in the post body to center-crop instead.
- **TikTok and YouTube** require a video; **Instagram** accepts images or video.
- **Reddit, Pinterest, Slack, Discord, Google Business** can be connected (OAuth via
  Bundle) but posting requires platform-specific fields (subreddit/board/channel)
  that are not wired up yet — treat as placeholders.
